snippet.title: Gurei | Steam PC | Official Next Fest Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by classic Japanese chambara cinema, Gurei invites players to embody Rei, a human spirit on a mission to defeat the mystical Kami and absorb their powers. 

With each victory, Rei gains new abilities, along with unexpected piece of stories and commentaries from the defeated Kami, enriching the narrative and gameplay experience. The game’s nonlinear boss structure and dynamic difficulty system ensure that each encounter is shaped by player choice, offering a unique challenge with every playthrough. 

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191280
